exposure: self-efficacy strategies (step-by-step progression, learning from vicarious experience, verbal persuasion, physiological arousal, mindfulness training)
outcome: weight gain control within recommended range
self-efficacy in eating behaviors (availability, social pressure, negative emotion, positive emotion, physical discomfort)
cohort: 141 overweight and obese pregnant women, ranging from 16-24 weeks gestational age, attending healthcare centers in Dezful city, Iran.
finding: Self-efficacy-based psychological training significantly improved weight gain control within the recommended range and enhanced self-efficacy scores and eating behaviors among overweight and obese pregnant women.
